greeting: Ah, you are back. Do come in.
Hello again. The leaves have been very quiet.
chatter: There is always something to notice among the leaves.
A quiet room makes a good reading place.
I do most of my reading after dark.
Every leaf has its own little pattern, if you look closely.
A high place makes even a small room feel wide.
I find a soft light much kinder than a bright one.
dislike: That is a little too lively for my reading corner.
Perhaps that belongs in a busier room.
Oh dear. That will not sit quietly at all.
stripped: Oh dear. Something I was fond of has gone missing.
I was sure there was something lovely here. How odd.
intro: Hello. I am the Owl. A leafy view and a high perch would suit me nicely.
I am a quiet sort. I read the leaves, mostly at night.

wantAnnounce.leafy-perch: Could I have a high place beside some leaves?
wantAnnounce.glow-among-leaves: A little light among the leaves would help me read.
wantAnnounce.reading-nook: I would love a cosy nook with a picture to study.
wantAnnounce.lamplit-perch: Could a lamp sit right beside my perch?
wantAnnounce.night-garden: I dream of a room full of leaves, pictures and glow.

leafy-perch: Just the view I was hoping for.
From up here, every leaf looks like a little page.
I think I shall read the room for a while.
glow-among-leaves: There. The leaves look warm in that light.
I can see every vein, like lines on a page.
Thank you. My evenings will be much brighter now.
reading-nook: A picture to study and somewhere cosy to sit.
I may close my eyes for just a moment.
Only to rest them, of course.
Do not let me sleep past moonrise.
lamplit-perch: Light beside my perch, just where I like it.
Now I can read late into the night.
night-garden: Leaves, pictures and a gentle glow. It is all here.
When I first came, this room was so very quiet.
It is still quiet. But now it is a good quiet.
I think I shall stay for a long, long while.

wants.brief: A leafy view from a high perch
A soft glow among the leaves
A cosy nook with a picture to study
A lamp beside a high perch
